---
title: "HTTP Status shortcode example"
format: html
---

An informational response is {{< http-status 100 >}}.

A successful response is {{< http-status 200 >}}.

A redirect is {{< http-status 301 >}}.

A missing resource returns {{< http-status 404 >}}.

A rate-limited request returns {{< http-status 429 >}}.

A server failure returns {{< http-status 503 >}}.
